run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset datapoint using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE Atoms or pymatgen Structure with specified supercell and displacement parameters
produce_force_constants: compute forces for displaced supercells and produce force constants using a Phonopy object and ASE calculator
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies in THz at supercell commensurate points or a given set of qpoints
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity from a Phonopy object over a temperature range
